description: Open a non-custodial swap and return a one-time deposit address. Use it only after the user has seen a quote, agreed to the amount and route, and given you both addresses. from_asset, to_asset and amount mean the same as in get_quote: pass the values the user agreed to. destination_address must be on to_asset's chain and refund_address on from_asset's chain, usually the sending wallet; BTC to ZEC, for example, needs a Zcash payout address and a Bitcoin refund address. NEVER invent, guess or reuse addresses from elsewhere in the conversation. Set protocol only to keep the route the user picked from get_quote's alternatives. The tool re-quotes with the real addresses, sets the minimum output from that quote and returns an error rather than a deposit if the amounts changed. Nothing moves until the user sends exactly send_exactly from their own wallet before expires_at; the server never holds keys or signs. If the swap cannot complete, funds go back to refund_address. Each call creates a new deposit address, so do not call it again to "retry" a swap the user already funded. Rate-limited per caller (about 6 swaps in a burst, then one every 20 seconds).

amount.description: Exact amount of from_asset the user will send, in normal decimal units ("100", "0.05"), not base units.

destination_address.description: Address the user gave you on the destination chain (to_asset's chain). Swapped funds are paid here.

from_asset.description: Source (what the user sends). asset. Either an exact asset_id from list_assets ("BASE.USDC-0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913") or CHAIN.SYMBOL shorthand ("ZEC.ZEC", "BTC.BTC", "ETH.ETH", "SOL.SOL", "BASE.USDC"). Shorthand resolves to the verified asset; if it is ambiguous the error lists the exact ids to use.

protocol.description: Optional. Pin this route, e.g. the alternative the user chose from get_quote. Omit to use the best route at creation time.

refund_address.description: Address the user gave you on the source chain (from_asset's chain), usually the wallet they send from. Refunds go here if the swap fails or the price drops below the floor.

to_asset.description: Destination (what the user receives). asset. Either an exact asset_id from list_assets ("BASE.USDC-0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913") or CHAIN.SYMBOL shorthand ("ZEC.ZEC", "BTC.BTC", "ETH.ETH", "SOL.SOL", "BASE.USDC"). Shorthand resolves to the verified asset; if it is ambiguous the error lists the exact ids to use.

name: create_swap

deposit_address.description: One-time address to send the funds to.

deposit_memo.description: Memo the deposit MUST carry, or null when none is needed.

destination_address.description: Payout address, echoed back for the user to check.

expected_out.description: Expected payout with asset and chain.

expires_at.description: ISO time after which the deposit address must not be used.

explorer_url.description: Public tracking link, when the route has one.

minimum_out.description: Guaranteed minimum payout; below this the swap refunds.

next_step.description: What to tell the user next.

refund_address.description: Refund address, echoed back for the user to check.

send_exactly.description: Exact amount, asset and chain the user must send.

token_contract.description: Token contract of from_asset, when it is a token rather than a native coin.

warnings.description: Must be shown to the user (memo requirements, unverified tokens).

title: Create a swap (deposit address)
